video_title: Shams Charania's early TOP-5 MVP list + Yaxel Lendeborg's RISE for Warriors 📈 | The Pat McAfee Show

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Early season injury wave affecting multiple NBA All-Stars
quotes.excerpt: Unfortunately that's been a big part of the early start. You look at all of these All-Stars.
quotes.quote: Unfortunately that's been a big part of the early start. You look at all of these All-Stars that are out. Tyrese Haliburton, Anthony Edwards out for at least two months, Kawhi Leonard, Paolo Banchero, Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Duren, Ja Morant, Jaren Jackson Jr. There's different prongs to all these injuries. I look at Kawhi Leonard and Anthony Edwards, this is wear and tear for them. Then you have Jalen Williams, Jaren Jackson Jr., and Paolo Banchero, all having freak injuries basically. Guys running into their leg. Jalen Williams had an awful scene in Oklahoma City on October 25th when he came down under on his leg, dislocating his ankle and fracturing his leg. That was nasty. Tyrese Haliburton, Ja Morant, those are soft tissue injuries here early in the season.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder's early season injury crisis and historic roster losses
quotes.excerpt: In one night, in the same game on October 25th, they lose three starters for 20 games.
quotes.quote: Chet Holmgren, he suffers an injury on October 25th as well. The Thunder looked like they were the team to beat, that they were going to go and potentially win a championship when they dismantled the Spurs on opening night. In one night, in the same game on October 25th, they lose three starters for 20 games or more. That's the first time in NBA history that a team has lost three starters for 20 games or more on the same night. Just devastating for them. They also are obviously without Cason Wallace, he had a freak injury, and Jalen Suggs. Injuries have definitely taken storm over the first part of the year.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's elite scoring and defensive growth this season
quotes.excerpt: He's not just the best scorer in the NBA now, he's one of the best scorers of all-time.
quotes.quote: Luka Doncic has been a treat to watch. The guy is putting up 40-point burgers every single night. Giannis Antetokounmpo last night actually said he's not just the best scorer in the NBA now, he's one of the best scorers of all-time. You're already starting to see praise come Luka Doncic's way. Defensively, that's the biggest point. He's gotten a lot of flak over the years on defense, but you're seeing him take more charges this year to get turnovers. He's averaging more steals this year, and when I talk to people in LA, they're seeing him take more ownership on defense than ever before.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Shams Charania's early season MVP candidate rankings
quotes.excerpt: I look at Luka Doncic, Tyrese Maxey in Philadelphia, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Victor Wembanyama, Jayson Tatum, and Cade Cunningham.
quotes.quote: I don't do rankings, but I'll do rankings for you, Pat. I look at Luka Doncic, Tyrese Maxey in Philadelphia after he's led them, he's their number one guy right now, even Jaylen Brown has admitted it. It's to the point where LeBron James is running into the audience, drinking his wine during the game. I would look at Luka Doncic, Tyrese Maxey, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Victor Wembanyama, Jayson Tatum, and Cade Cunningham. Those are my five or six guys that I'm looking at right now as far as MVP so far this season.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick's coaching intensity and relationship with Lakers stars
quotes.excerpt: JJ Redick is one of the most intense coaches I think in the NBA.
quotes.quote: JJ Redick is one of the most intense coaches I think in the NBA, but he's had the full support of the two people that matter the most, Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves. Luka Doncic and JJ Redick actually played together in Dallas. They've been full steam ahead, they've been completely locked in. They can talk to each other in ways that not many players and coaches can talk to each other because of the mutual respect they have. Those guys have always been on the same page, and JJ Redick has been getting a lot out of this team already this year.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum's role and Celtics' Eastern Conference outlook
quotes.excerpt: Getting Paul George, a two-way player to go alongside Jayson Tatum, the pecking order is very clear.
quotes.quote: I think Jayson Tatum is going to put up big numbers all year. Getting Paul George, a two-way player to go alongside Jayson Tatum, the pecking order is very clear. This is Jayson Tatum's team, I'm here to elevate him. That is the biggest difference for the Celtics clearly. The Celtics made a decision, they wanted to go in a different direction, whether it was finances, whether it was the team style, they felt Jayson Tatum was their guy. Tatum is going to put up big numbers this year. The question is going to be how high do they finish in the Eastern Conference. If they finish with the number one or number two seed, you have to look at Jayson Tatum as a top-three MVP candidate.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's disciplinary status following recent on-court incident
quotes.excerpt: I do not expect him to have any more discipline on that.
quotes.quote: As far as Draymond Green is concerned though, I can report I do not expect him to have any more discipline on that. I don't expect the NBA to discipline Draymond Green any further for this play right here. So don't expect anything more, but Draymond clearly got his lick in right there.
